resumenEn:
The Officer Edition of CONSCRIPT contains:
• CONSCRIPT base game
• Trench Raider Pack
• CONSCRIPT Digital Soundtrack
Trench Raider Pack
Battle through the trenches with 3 additional uniforms to choose from in the Trench Raider Pack, containing:
• Elite Trench Raider
• Pilot
• English Tommy
Digital Soundtrack
Relive the haunting atmosphere of one of the most bloody battles of World War 1 with the CONSCRIPT Digital Soundtrack
